chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ حَمْدَانَ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Muhammad ibn Masud, from Abu Ja'far Hamdan ibn Ahmad, from Muawiya ibn Hukaym, from Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَّانِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ، قَالَ: وَلَا أَعْلَمُ إِلَّا قَامَ وَنَفَضَ الْفِرَاشَ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي: يَا أَحْمَدُ، إِنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَادَ صَعْصَعَةَ بْنَ صُوحَانَ فِي مَرَضِهِ، فَقَالَ: يَا صَعْصَعَةُ لَا تَتَّخِذْ عِيَادَتِي لَكَ أَبَاهَةً عَلَى قَوْمِكَ، قَالَ: فَلَمَّا قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ لِصَعْصَعَةَ هَذِهِ الْمَقَالَةَ، قَالَ صَعْصَعَةُ: بَلَى وَاللَّهِ أَعِدُّهَا نِعْمَةً مِنَ اللَّهِ عَلَيَّ وَفَضْلًا، قَالَ: فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: إِنِّي كُنْتُ مَا عَلِمْتُكَ إِلَّا لِخَفِيفِ الْمُؤُونَةِ حَسَنَ الْمُعُونَةِ، قَالَ: فَقَالَ صَعْصَعَةُ: وَأَنْتَ وَاللَّهِ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَا عَلِمْتُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلِيمًا، وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفًا رَحِيمًا

translations.en: I was with Abi al-Hasan the Second (peace be upon him). He said: And I do not know [what happened next] except that he stood and shook the bed-wrap with his hand, then said to me: O Ahmad, indeed the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) visited Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan in his illness and said: O Sa'sa'ah, do not take my visiting you as a source of pride/status over your people. He said: When the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said these words to Sa'sa'ah, Sa'sa'ah said: Yes, by Allah, I will count it as a grace from Allah upon me and a favour. He said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to him: I have not known you except as one with scanty resources but excellent support [of the truth]. Sa'sa'ah said: And you, by Allah, O Commander of the Faithful, I have not known you except as cognizant of Allah, and compassionate and merciful to the believers.

en.summary: This hadith from Rijal al-Kashshi highlights the etiquette of visitation (‘iyadah) and the delicate balance between humility and dignity, as Imam Ali advised Sa’sa’ah not to let the visit become a source of social arrogance. The exchange underscores the Shia emphasis on the Imam’s profound knowledge of his companions' character, praising Sa’sa’ah for his modesty despite limited means, while Sa’sa’ah reciprocates by affirming the Imam’s divine insight and mercy. This interaction serves as a practical model for maintaining spiritual humility during social interactions with religious leaders.
en.seo_question: What was the interaction between Imam Ali and Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan during his illness?

key_terms.صَعْصَعَةُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ: Sa'sa'ah ibn Suhan, a companion of Imam Ali
key_terms.أَبَاهَةً: Pride, status, or source of distinction
